body.statement: Using the inverse Hall equality handle, characterize all \((\mu_0,\mu_1,\alpha)\) for which either \(I^*/k^*=(2L-1)/3\) or \(I^*-k^*=2L-4\), and determine whether simultaneous equality outside the symmetric endpoint-heavy family is possible when every marginal cell is positive.
body.justification: An equality classification would turn the worst-case bound into a diagnostic theory of when interval reporting is maximally costly.
body.gap: Neither the causal transport literature nor structured conformal prediction gives inverse equality conditions for a coupling-robust interval penalty.
body.consumer: The classification would identify which marginal shapes warrant routine reporting of disconnected effect sets rather than intervals.
